description: This file defines schema components and utility functions for supporting tables in a ProseMirror-based editor, including node specifications, attribute handling, and schema creation functions.

methods.name: getCellAttrs
methods.description: Extracts cell attributes from a DOM element or string, including colspan, rowspan, and colwidth, incorporating extra attributes.

methods.name: setCellAttrs
methods.description: Generates attribute object for a table cell node based on its attributes and extra attributes.

methods.name: validateColwidth
methods.description: Validates that the colwidth attribute is either null or an array of numbers.

methods.name: tableNodes
methods.description: Creates node specifications for table, row, cell, and header nodes with configurable cell content and attributes.

methods.name: tableNodeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves node types for table roles from a schema, caching the result for efficiency.
